comparison.objective: Turn a TPR-valve test knob and report whether it moves freely or is obstructed; candidate adjusts, locks, and dynamically tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Quarter-turn knob actuation and condition-dependent tag placement versus hex-bit insertion, captive-screw loosening, bit withdrawal, fine collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Knob moved at least 15 degrees while seated and tag placed on the pad matching free or blocked behavior versus two repeatable axial stops under quantified energy, travel, velocity, and force limits.
comparison.reason: Both couple rotation with diagnosis, but the valve task tests pass/fail travel and reporting; it does not test locking a selected setting or iterative dynamic-response commissioning.
